d: In this video, Firstpost explains how Florida is battling a historic flood crisis as record-breaking rainfall submerges neighbourhoods, swells rivers and triggers emergency evacuations. Melbourne has shattered November rainfall records, while Fort Lauderdale, Vero Beach and West Palm Beach face unprecedented downpours. With the St Johns River breaching historic levels, fears are mounting over further flooding. But could El Niño bring a wetter, stormier Florida winter? And how is climate change intensifying extreme rainfall and increasing flood risks? Gursshheen Gahllen brings you the…
